newsitem.title: USA: FPL sees Turkey Pt power plant back Thursday.
newsitem.headline: FPL sees Turkey Pt power plant back Thursday.

text.p: Florida Power & Light Co said Thursday its 666 megawatt (MW) Turkey Point 3 nuclear power plant would likely resume power production later today following an unscheduled repair outage that began Wednesday.
"We had to do some repairs to circuitry for some of our control rods. We expect to restart this morning and be on line this afternoon," said company spokeswoman Janice Brady.

The Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said in its daily status report the plant was shut to investigate and repair a control rod, and that the plant was being kept on "hot standby," typically indicating a prompt restart is expected.
Brady said power demand in the company's service territory was "pretty low" and that the company did not expect any problems meeting demand during the outage.
The Turkey Point facility is in Florida City, Fla.
The adjacent unit, Turkey Point 4, was unaffected by the outage and producing at its full 666 MW rating, Brady said.
